title: Moderated New-User Study: Unprompted Next-Board Routing Comprehension

targetAcceptanceCriteria.prerequisiteBlocker: No human participants recruited or tested; actual user comprehension cannot be fabricated.

taskDesign.objective: Determine whether novice players deduce the Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe routing rule (the cell selected in the local mini-board determines the active mini-board for the opponent's subsequent turn) without explicit coaching or hints.
taskDesign.targetRule: Move at (b, c) forces the opponent's next move to mini-board c, provided mini-board c is open and undecided.

perfect.description: Participant unpromptedly selects and executes legal move in the dictated active mini-board on first interaction without guidance.

partial.description: Participant initially taps a disabled mini-board, observes UI constraint indicator (active border highlight / subtle shake), and immediately selects the correct board without verbal intervention.

failure.description: Participant expresses confusion, requires facilitator explanation, or relies on tutorial hint/continue button.

setupInstructions.facilitatorScript: Welcome. Today you will be trying Mega XO. Your goal is to align three mini-boards in a row to win the overall match. Please take your first five moves against the computer opponent as you would normally play.
setupInstructions.deviceConfiguration: Native iOS WKWebView or Android WebView test build running on reference hardware, initialized in clean state (no prior local storage or cached saves).
setupInstructions.moderatorRole: Strictly observational. Do not offer unsolicited tips, point at active boards, or explain the destination rule during the 5-move evaluation window.

privacyAndEthics.piiGuarantee: Zero participant names, emails, biometrics, camera recordings, or device serials are recorded or transmitted.
privacyAndEthics.anonymization: Participants assigned randomized tokens (e.g., P-01 through P-20).
privacyAndEthics.dataRetention: Anonymized scoring tallies stored locally; no telemetry sent to third parties.
privacyAndEthics.voluntaryParticipation: Participants may withdraw at any time without penalty.

currentStatusLedger.conclusion: UNMET_PREREQUISITE: Requires real human participant recruitment and moderated evaluation sessions. Preparation does not mark task done.
